- **Lewis & Clark — San Diego admission representative:** **Qwadere “Q” Lovell**, Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions, covers Southern California (the county assignment page specifically assigns **San Diego** to him). Contact: [qlovell@lclark.edu](mailto:qlovell@lclark.edu), **503-713-1203**. [County assignment](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/) · [staff profile](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell)

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW, Fall 2026:** The published fall MSW application deadline is **March 1**; supporting documents are due **March 15**. Silberman lists this for the two-year full-time, Bank Street dual-degree, advanced-standing, and one-year-residency options. [Official deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

- **Indiana University Kokomo — full current graduate-program inventory:** The university’s graduate offerings page describes its inventory as master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate work. The current academic catalog returns **22 master’s programs** and **16 graduate certificates**:
  - **Master’s:** MAT Biology; MBA Business Administration; MAT Chemistry; MS Criminal Justice and Public Safety; MS Educational Technology for Learning; MA English; MS Family Nurse Practitioner; MA History; MAT History; Master of Liberal Studies; MS Management; MAT Mathematics; MA Mental Health Counseling; MS Management (the Accounting/Business Administration online-to-MS pathway); MS Nursing Administration; MS Nursing Education; MA Political Science; MAT Political Science; Master of Public Management; MS Science of Reading; MS Strategic Finance; and MS Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum.
  - **Graduate certificates:** Alcohol and Drug Counseling; Biology; Business Fundamentals; Chemistry; Communication Studies; Composition Studies; Criminal Justice Leadership and Management; Health Management; History; Language and Literature; Leadership; Literature; Mathematics; Political Science; Public Management; and Teaching English Learners.
  - **Postbaccalaureate certificates shown in the catalog:** Accounting and Advanced Medical Imaging Technology.  
  [Graduate-program overview](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html) · [official catalog—master’s filter](https://kokomo.iu.edu/academics/index.html?program_type=7) · [official catalog—graduate-certificate filter](https://kokomo.iu.edu/academics/index.html?program_type=3)

- **UCSF/Northern California glioblastoma trials currently recruiting:** UCSF’s glioblastoma finder labels these as **“open to eligible people”** (i.e., recruiting):
  - **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — **San Francisco, California**; open to eligible people age 18+.  
  - **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — **San Francisco, California and other locations**; open to eligible people age 18+.  
  Other currently open UCSF-listed examples include the **FRONTIER** TheraSphere GBM-device study and the **MOAB** recurrent-glioblastoma study, both shown as San Francisco and other locations. [UCSF’s live glioblastoma-trial listing](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma)

- **Oral Roberts University student activities/student experience:** ORU’s current Student Life team page does **not** use the exact title “Director of Student Activities.” The closest current director-level student-experience role listed is **Chandler Petrak, M.Div., Director of Spiritual Life & Student Experience** — [cpetrak@oru.edu](mailto:cpetrak@oru.edu), **918-495-6664**. ORU also lists **Augustine Mendoza** as **Director of Spiritual Life**, [augiemendoza@oru.edu](mailto:augiemendoza@oru.edu), **918-495-7727**. [Current Student Life team](https://oru.edu/life-at-oru/student-life/meet-the-team.php) · [Student Life administration](https://oru.edu/about-oru/administration/vice-president-student-life.php)

- **EDF graduate programme / salary reviews:** **No.** I found no statement on EDF’s current Graduate Careers page saying that new graduate hires receive salary reviews, so there is no exact salary-review wording to quote from that page. The page discusses programme opportunities, applications, and recruitment FAQs, but does not state a salary-review policy. [EDF Graduate Careers](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers)
